name: Aran
description: An Aran knit: twisted rope cables running up the piece between panels of seed stitch, all in cream wool.

code.style: --rule: ( --k: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } @match(x % 3 == 2) { z-index: @calc(100 - @y); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 20%; top: -24%; width: 60%; height: 148%; border-radius: 50%; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-transform: rotate(40deg); transform: rotate(40deg); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #00000073, #000 30% 62%, #00000099); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #00000073, #000 30% 62%, #00000099); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @var(--k); opacity: .55; -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, transparent 2%, #000 2% 8%, transparent 8%, transparent 92%, #000 92% 98%, transparent 98%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, transparent 2%, #000 2% 8%, transparent 8%, transparent 92%, #000 92% 98%, transparent 98%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } @match(x % 3 != 2) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); opacity: .8; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(17% 17% at 25% 25%, #000 55%, transparent 100%) 0 0 / 50% 50%, radial-gradient(17% 17% at 75% 75%, #000 55%, transparent 100%) 0 0 / 50% 50%; mask: radial-gradient(17% 17% at 25% 25%, #000 55%, transparent 100%) 0 0 / 50% 50%, radial-gradient(17% 17% at 75% 75%, #000 55%, transparent 100%) 0 0 / 50% 50%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
